patch.value: Use a strictly sequential orchestrator-owned pipeline (no parallel lanes) to simplify auditability and deterministic replay. (DEC1)
Single comprehensive Freeze bundle is the only acceptance event (no partial-freeze semantics in this branch). (DEC2)
Deny-by-default tool permissions with sandboxed execution; network access denied by baseline policy; repo writes only via patch_apply of diff-only patchsets. (DEC6)
Enforce canonical-only planning semantics: accept plan_package_final.json (and structured handoff bundle) as sole authoritative input; deviations require ChangeRequest + escalation. (DEC8)
Mandate checkpointing via stage_handoff artifacts at every stage transition; absence blocks progress. (DEC3)
Single evidence standard across all canonical artifacts: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer objects into versioned JSON artifacts; no alternate citation formats. (DEC4)
Canonical JSON artifact modifications only via RFC 6902 JSON Patch; code changes only via diff-only patchset JSON artifacts. (DEC5)
Smallest-passing-repair selection is deterministic (fewest ops, fewest bytes, first-generated) when multiple passing repairs exist. (DEC5)

Freeze is permitted only when all closure gates pass (quality, security, integrity, workspace integrity, reproducibility, trace completeness, risk closure) and every decision/waiver is evidence-backed. (DEC2)
